decisions.note: Round-1 spec had user typing title manually, no auto-fetch; client demanded auto title/description/favicon collection.
Round-1 spec's duplicate flow asked 'save anyway'; client rejected it and specified quietly editing the existing bookmark instead.
Round-1 spec deferred search/tags to P3 'at scale'; client rejected the deferral, insisting they be in from the start.
Round-1 spec had no note field at all; client asked for a personal note per bookmark.
Round-1 spec had no archive concept; client asked for a reversible 'set aside' distinct from permanent delete.
Round-1 spec had no read/unread state; client requested read-later marking and an unread-only view.
Round-1 spec had no sort control; client asked to choose sort order (newest/title).
Round-2 revised spec still had no bulk operations; client asked to select multiple/whole-filtered-set for batch tag/read/archive/delete.
Round-2 spec's tag entry had no autocomplete; client asked for existing-tag suggestions to avoid duplicate tag spellings.
Round-2 spec's search lacked exact-phrase and tag-scoped/boolean narrowing; client asked for quoted-phrase and word+tag combination.
Round-2 spec had no import/export; client asked to bring in existing browser bookmarks and be able to export them back out.
Round-2 spec kept no copy of the saved page; client asked for the app to preserve the page content in case the original disappears.

Maker framed snapshot fidelity as defer/reader-text/full-fidelity and the client picked lightweight reader-mode text extraction, which does not satisfy the reference's 'preserve a snapshot of the page as local HTML (single file)' requirement — accepted without correction (satisficing miss).
Round-3 snapshot proposal said nothing about PDF targets; client asked for the PDF-instead-of-snapshot case to be handled, matching the reference's explicit PDF rule.
Round-3 spec had no saved-filter concept; client asked to save a recurring search+tag combination for reuse (bundle).
Round-3 spec's notes were plain text; client asked for basic formatting (bold/list/link) to render on read-back.

Built MVP silently no-op'd on re-saving a duplicate URL instead of guiding the user to the existing bookmark; client flagged the silence and asked for it to jump into the existing item, per the spec's own FR-017/REF-BM-06 intent.

Before search was built, client proactively required that archived bookmarks stay excluded from normal search/filter results, pre-empting a divergence from the reference's archive-hides-from-search edge case.

Delivered search (round 10) only offered quoted-phrase and single tag+keyword narrowing; the reference's AND/OR/NOT-with-parentheses boolean query language was never implemented or requested, and the client approved the feature as complete (satisficing miss).
Round-11 batch actions shipped 'add tag' only; client asked for batch 'remove tag' to match the reference's add/remove-tags bulk action.
Round-12 import stamped all imported bookmarks with today's date instead of preserving original ADD_DATE; client caught this and required the original save dates be kept.

Reference requires auto-collecting a preview image alongside title/description/favicon; the preview image was dropped after round 1 and never implemented or raised again by either party (satisficing miss).
